## Other methods and analyses

- [**Splitgate Backend: a local replacement for game service endpoints**](https://github.com/SplitgateDevelopment/Backend) - Splitgate Backend implements local TypeScript service routes for the game's backend and redirects Splitgate's AccelByte requests to them through Fiddler or mitmproxy. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/splitgate-backend-case/)</sub>
- [**SR1 Creator: rebuilding the Saints Row character creator**](https://github.com/00xJS/SR1-Creator) - SR1 Creator recreates the Saints Row (2006) character creator in a browser using meshes, morph targets, textures and tables read from the user's Saints Reborn folder. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/sr1-creator-case/)</sub>
- [**StarCombat Offline: reconstructing a discontinued game's backend**](https://github.com/pkwd1/starcombat-offline) - StarCombat Offline reconstructs backend services for the discontinued mobile game Star Combat: Space battle Online. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: Protocol · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/starcombat-offline-case/)</sub>
- [**Summit: reconstructing a World of Warcraft 3.3.5a server**](https://github.com/paalgyula/summit) - Summit rebuilds a World of Warcraft 3.3.5a server in Go, with authentication, world-server and packet-handling components. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: Protocol · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/summit-wow-server-case/)</sub>
- [**Super Mario Galaxy 2: selected gravity behavior and format reconstruction**](https://github.com/alexkypraiou/smg2-reverse-engineering) - Super Mario Galaxy 2: selected gravity behavior and format reconstruction implements host-side C++ versions of selected CubeGravity, PlanetGravity and PointGravity operations. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/smg2-reverse-engineering-case/)</sub>
